opening: My right ring finger is swollen.
The pain and swelling started 2 days ago, while I was playing football.
When I make a fist, I can't bend my right ring finger at the last joint.
When my hand is resting, my right ring finger stays straight.
I'm active in sports, especially football.

opening.text: Hi, I'm here because my right ring finger hurts and it's swollen. The pain and swelling started two days ago while I was playing football. I'm quite active in sports, especially football. Right now, when I make a fist, I can't bend my right ring finger at the last joint, and when my hand is resting, that finger just stays straight.
